Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We want to get a single 2-hour onboarding/orientation for our APAC product & infra teams that covers: a console walkthrough (UI + routing/workflow), an API enablement segment (keys, rate limits, examples), and a short hands-on lab so engineers can push a simple request.

Because our team is JST-based, evenings (Redwood late-afternoon / our early evening) work best. Would you have availability for one of these windows next week (all times JST):
- Tue 25 Nov, 18:30–20:30
- Wed 26 Nov, 19:00–21:00

We expect ~10 attendees (product, infra, SRE). Important pre-reqs: SSO test user + a sandbox service account with read-only logs. I attached a quick roster (CSV) with names and roles so you can confirm facilitators.

Also: can you run this as a tandem facilitation (one person on UI, one on API/lab)? We want distinct leads for questions.

Thanks,
Alicia

- Wed 26 Nov, 19:00–21:00 JST (10:00–12:00 UTC) — backup

Preflight checklist we need from you before the session:
- Confirm final attendee list (names + roles) — we saw ~10 in the CSV; please flag if others will join.
- Create one SSO test user that we can log in with (email + SSO provider).
- Provision a sandbox API key/service account for the lab (scoped to non-production, read/write token).

I’ve attached a preliminary agenda (prelim_agenda_v1.pdf) and a short runbook link — the runbook includes the lab steps and what we’ll ask participants to do during the hands-on portion. If Tue 25 works, we’ll reserve the sandbox cluster and send calendar invites with the lab artifacts and a short pre-work checklist 48 hours prior.

Let me know which window you prefer and any attendee conflicts. Ben is CC’d and will DM you post-invite to coordinate whether we need additional facilitators for breakout Q&A.
